'At the hour of the Tiger they raid the flanks, by the hour of the Goat they've broken the shafts — wherever the Dragon Banner passes, all becomes the land of Hao.'
'Amid ten thousand troops he seizes the very stars; alone before the ranks, he cuts down the war banner.'
'Iron robes gleam like snow, bones become a wall — not a single step of retreat, and thus eternal life.'
'Heaven and earth overturn, the banners change hands — the fate of mountains and rivers now rests in one's grasp.'
'The pinnacle of mechanical arts — crossbows like strings of pearls, cannons like peals of thunder, and in the blink of an eye, corpses lie strewn across the field.'
'The bow draws like a full moon, the arrow flies like a shooting star — taking an enemy's head from a thousand miles away is as easy as reaching into one's own pocket.'
